sys_atf_test.description: Enables outbound webhooks via system property, creates a Torq-sourced case with severity=3, updates severity to 1, and asserts a pending outbound webhook_log entry was created by the Create Outbound Webhook after-update business rule with event_type case.severity_changed. Cleans up test data and restores properties afterward.
sys_atf_test.name: Outbound Webhook Created on Severity Change
